research_note: Curated from primary pages, abstracts and project descriptions. Books, recordings and code were not fully read, watched or executed. No verified future conference match is included in this pass. Additions checked 2026-10-17; earlier entries retain their individual source dates.

resources.title: Firecracker: Lightweight Virtualization for Serverless Applications
resources.why: Explains the device, isolation and overhead choices behind a production microVM monitor.
resources.caveat: The publisher page includes the paper, slides and a recording; results describe the 2020 system.

resources.title: The KVM API
resources.why: Defines the VM, vCPU and memory interfaces used when building a Linux VMM.

resources.title: rust-vmm reference VMM
resources.why: Shows how reusable Rust virtualization components fit together in a small VMM.
resources.caveat: Reference implementation; no build or guest boot was performed.

resources.title: CS110L: Safety in Systems Programming
resources.why: Find systems-programming teaching material to review ownership and concurrency before studying a virtual machine monitor.
resources.caveat: The inspected schedule is from 2022; retain its historical context.

resources.title: Rust VMM code review report
resources.why: Read the scope and findings of a real rust-vmm audit alongside the workshop’s component and isolation choices.
resources.caveat: 2023 report; title, contents, and summary inspected, not independently audited.
